name: LOW FUEL 1/2
description: Respective supply tank fuel quantity below 26 kg. Warning Unit shows LOW FUEL1/LOW FUEL2 and audio tone, Master List shows FUEL1 LOW or LOW FUEL2, voice message "FUEL ONE/TWO, LOW". Endurance indication no longer shown.

procedure.heading: If one LOW FUEL warning light is on:
procedure.text: Expect single engine failure after approx. 10 minutes

procedure.heading: If both LOW FUEL warning lights are on:

procedure.text: After 8 minutes, a flameout of both engines must be expected. If no adequate landing site is found within 8 minutes, consider a power-on immediate landing.
If positive fuel indication in the main tank: check FUEL XFER PUMP A and F sw's ON, check FUEL XPMP - A and - F cb's in.
